Between:-
 Rahul @ Ramprakash S/O Shivram Gupta, Aged

 Indore (Madhya Pradesh)
 
 (By Shri Ajay Raj Gupta - Panel Lawyer)
 This application coming on for admission this day, the 
 following:
 Order

Applicant has filed this second bail application under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 on behalf of the applicant for grant of regular bail relating to Crime No.228/2022 registered at P.S. Palasia, District Indore (M.P.) for commission of offence punishable under Sections 420 and 409 of IPC.
He is in jail since 13.05.2022.

2. His earlier bail application was dismissed as withdrawn by this Court vide order dated 06.02.2023 passed in MCRC No.35424/2022.
3.
As per the prosecution story, co-accused Sushil Bhatia is the Owner of the "Seven Billion Networks Company" and present applicant Rahul is the Manager of the said Company.

Complainant Deepesh has given a written complaint to Police Station Palasia, District Indore by stating that present applicant and other co-accused told him that if he deposit the money in the said company he Rahul @ Ramprakash vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 21 June, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/193478853/
1 will get every month 15% return as an interest, therefore, he has deposited Rs.2,00,000/- on 17.11.2019.

entities.text: Rahul @ Ramprakash vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: After that, he got some return, therefore, he again deposited Rs.2,00,000/-, but the said amount was not returned to him by the aforesaid Company.
Present applicant and other co- accused persons have misappropriated the said amount and have committed cheating with him.

Accordingly,
a case has been registered against the applicant and other co-accused persons.
4. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that applicant is innocent person and he has been falsely implicated in this matter.
Applicant is in jail since 13.05.2022.
Investigation is over and charge-sheet has been filed.
Applicant is a permanent resident of District Indore.
There is no apprehension of his fleeing away from the court of justice.
There is no eye witness in the said incident and no evidence is available against him in respect of aforesaid offence.
Final conclusion of trial will take considerable long time.
Hence, he prays that applicant be released on bail.

5. Per-contra, learned counsel for respondent/State opposes the bail application and prays for its rejection by submitting that first bail application of applicant was dismissed as withdrawn by this Court vide order dated 06.02.2023 passed in MCRC No.35424/2022 and the first anticipatory bail application of other co-accused Kanchanbala was also dismissed as withdrawn with liberty to renew his prayer at an appropriate stage by this Court vide order dated 28.06.2022 passed in MCRC No.27867/2022.
Total 751 investors have been cheated by the present applicant and other co-accused persons.
Two more criminal antecedents have been found against the present applicant.
He is a habitual offender.
Hence, he does not deserve for bail.
6. Perused the case diary as well as the impugned order of the court below 7.

Considering all the facts and circumstances of the case, arguments advanced by counsel for the parties, nature and gravity of allegation as also taking note of the fact that present applicant has not produced the descriptions of other co-accused persons in the instant offence; he has given false information in Para 3 of this application; conduct of applicant appears to hide the necessary information and also to present false information before this Court; this is not fair on the part of the applicant; applicant has cheated 751 investors; he is a habitual offender; being a Manager of the aforesaid Company present applicant is responsible for the business of aforesaid Company.
8. In view of the evidence available on record, at this stage, this Court is not inclined to grant bail to the present applicant.
9. Accordingly, this second repeated bail application preferred under Section 439 of Cr.P.C. is rejected.
Certified copy as per rules.
(ANIL VERMA) JUDGE Anushree Rahul @ Ramprakash vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 21 June, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/193478853/
